subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: After the branch is rebased and CI is rerun, should OpenClaw accept this `announce:v1` session reconciliation and tool-free handoff policy as the intended fix for subagent completion announce restarts?
rationale: The implementation appears sound, but it intentionally changes session recovery state and a tool-execution security boundary, which should be accepted by an area owner rather than by cleanup automation alone.

options.title: Accept After Rebase
options.body: Rebase the branch, rerun required checks, and land if the session-state and security-boundary behavior still matches this reviewed shape.

options.title: Narrow The Policy
options.body: Keep the tool isolation but adjust the recovery state transition if maintainers prefer a different non-running terminal status than `killed` for aborted announce delivery.

options.title: Pause For Broader Isolation
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want the broader metadata-only subagent completion contract in the related issue to define the permanent boundary first.

recommendation.title: Accept After Rebase
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, rerun required checks, and land if the session-state and security-boundary behavior still matches this reviewed shape.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main agent/session work and broad history in the affected recovery path make this the best available routing signal.
